root_cause.text: red_dequeue() directly calls child->dequeue() instead of using qdisc_dequeue_peeked(), which fails to retrieve the skb that was already dequeued into the child's internal buffer (gso_skb) during the preceding peek, causing a null pointer dereference when the child's dequeue tries to operate on inconsistent state.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "When red qdisc has children (eg qfq qdisc) whose peek() callback is qdisc_peek_dequeued(), we could get a kernel panic... red will call the child's dequeue() which will essentially just try to grab something of qfq's queue." The panic trace shows a null-pointer dereference in qfq_dequeue invoked from red_dequeue. The patch fixes this by replacing `child->dequeue(child)` with `qdisc_dequeue_peeked(child)`.
